# Destiny Laboratories

> Destiny Laboratories Private Limited develops and markets pharmaceutical and nutraceutical formulations across women's health, bone and joint care, neurology, gastroenterology, anti-infective, steroidal and nutrition segments, with PCD franchise and distribution opportunities. Registered office: Khata No. 244, Khasra No. 91 & 92, Central Hope Town, Vikas Nagar, Dehradun, Uttarakhand 248197, India.
